description: ECON — explicit clothed humans optimised via normal integration; high-fidelity 3D clothed human from a single image, SMPL-X animatable

description: PIXIE — collaborative regression of expressive bodies: whole-body SMPL-X with detailed face and hand articulation from a single image

description: MediaPipe — cross-platform ML perception pipelines; Pose infers 33 3D body landmarks in real time on phone, desktop and web
notes: Zero-friction patient-side tracker for the live twin. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): Apache-2.0.

description: MMPose — OpenMMLab pose estimation toolbox and benchmark, including the RTMPose real-time model family
notes: Production/swappable 2D-pose layer under Pose2Sim-style pipelines. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): Apache-2.0.

description: GVHMR — world-grounded human motion recovery via gravity-view coordinates; SMPL motion in camera and world frames from monocular video
notes: Gravity/world frame is essential for posture (vs camera-frame pose). License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): NOASSERTION.

description: EasyMocap — multi-view and monocular SMPL/SMPL-X/MANO motion capture toolkit
notes: Clinic-grade multi-camera tier for higher-accuracy twin sessions. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): NOASSERTION.

description: Sapiens — high-resolution foundation models for human-centric vision: 2D pose, body-part segmentation, depth and normals
notes: Dense human perception front-end (keypoints + parts) for twin fitting. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): NOASSERTION.

description: Sapiens2 — 1K-resolution human vision transformers pretrained on 1B human images; pose, segmentation, normals, pointmaps, matting
notes: Successor to Sapiens; evaluate against Sapiens v1 before adopting. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): NOASSERTION.

description: SlimeVR Server — server for the SlimeVR open full-body tracking ecosystem; fuses IMU trackers into a full-body pose
notes: Sensor-suit hub: the wearable side of the 1:1 twin without cameras. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): Apache-2.0.

description: SlimeVR Tracker firmware for ESP32/ESP8266 and various IMUs — DIY open-hardware body trackers
notes: Buildable/buyable IMU trackers; pairs with SlimeVR-Server. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): Apache-2.0.

description: Lab Streaming Layer (LSL) — multimodal time-synchronised data transmission and recording (liblsl, pylsl, LabRecorder/XDF ecosystem)
notes: Sync layer that keeps video + IMU + EMG + haptic streams aligned for a true 1:1 twin. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): NOASSERTION.

description: DeepLabCut — markerless pose estimation of user-defined features with deep learning (animals incl. humans)
notes: Use when rehab needs custom landmarks (e.g. scapula/pelvis) trained on your own labelled video. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): LGPL-3.0.

description: DeepLabCut-Live — SDK for running DeepLabCut models on a live video stream
notes: Real-time companion to DeepLabCut for live custom-landmark tracking. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): NOASSERTION.

description: Real-time SMPL-X in Unity — shape reconstruction via a Python server plus MediaPipe pose in Unity, animating SMPL-X live
notes: Reference implementation for the missing live-twin Unity front-end (example code, not a product). License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): MIT.

description: Framework for quality assessment of physical rehabilitation exercises on the UI-PRMD dataset (skeletal joint data, correct vs incorrect movements)
notes: Teaches the agent what 'wrong' looks like for standard rehab exercises. License: not declared in GitHub API metadata (2026-10-21) — check upstream repo.

description: Graph convolutional networks for assessment of physical rehabilitation exercises (KIMORE and UI-PRMD)
notes: Clinician-scored exercise quality (KIMORE includes patients) — core for the correction layer. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): MIT.

description: MDM — Human Motion Diffusion Model; text/action-to-motion generation plus motion editing and in-betweening
notes: Generates a 'corrected' movement to show the patient. MUST be constrained by SKEL/OpenSim joint limits; diffusion alone can produce anatomically impossible motion. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): MIT.

description: OpenSim Moco — solve optimal control problems for musculoskeletal models with direct collocation (muscle activity for observed/corrected motion, motion prediction)
notes: Standalone repo is ARCHIVED; development moved into opensim-core (already catalogued). Listed so the capability is discoverable. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): Apache-2.0. ARCHIVED upstream (read-only).

description: OpenSimRT — real-time musculoskeletal kinematics and dynamics analysis using marker- and IMU-based solutions
notes: Real-time biofeedback path (e.g. gait retraining) on top of OpenSim. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): GPL-3.0.

description: CEINMS — Calibrated EMG-Informed Neuromusculoskeletal Modelling Toolbox; estimates muscle forces and joint moments calibrated to the individual, OpenSim-compatible
notes: The muscle-personalisation layer: without EMG-informed calibration, 'underdeveloped muscle' claims are generic-model guesses. A real-time variant (CEINMS-RT) targets wearable-robot control. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): Apache-2.0.

description: SOFA — real-time multi-physics simulation with emphasis on medical simulation; FEM soft-tissue modelling
notes: Muscle/soft-tissue deformation layer — MuJoCo/MyoSuite muscles are line actuators and cannot show bulge/atrophy visually. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): LGPL-2.1.

description: OpenExo — open-source modular exoskeleton platform for mobility and rehabilitation research: mechanical designs, electronics, firmware, control and biofeedback schemes
notes: KEY hardware repo: the buildable exoskeleton base (hip/ankle/elbow configurations). License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): NOASSERTION.

description: Open-Source Leg — open-source SDK for developing and testing algorithms on robotic prosthesis/exoskeleton leg hardware (actuators and sensors)
notes: Lower-limb actuator/sensor control stack; prosthesis-first but transferable to exo legs. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): LGPL-2.1.

description: SenseShift firmware — open-source firmware for DIY haptic-feedback devices (vest, gloves, sleeves), compatible with bHaptics and OpenGloves protocols
notes: The posture-cueing suit: vibrate where posture breaks. Haptic cueing is buildable today, unlike powered spinal support. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): GPL-3.0.

description: LucidGloves — Arduino/ESP32 DIY VR haptic gloves with force feedback, via OpenGloves
notes: Hand-rehab niche only; not a body/posture solution. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): MIT.

description: moteus — open-source brushless DC servo motor controller (firmware and PCB designs)
notes: Actuator controller for actual joint-support torque in an exo build. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): Apache-2.0.

description: Arduino SimpleFOC — field-oriented control library for BLDC and stepper motors across Arduino/STM32/ESP32-class hardware
notes: Cheapest path to custom actuator control for exo prototyping. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): MIT.

description: Tool for robust segmentation of >100 important anatomical structures in CT and MR images
notes: Accuracy-first onboarding: patient bone/muscle/organ geometry from their own MRI/CT, replacing statistical guessing. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): Apache-2.0.

description: nnU-Net — self-configuring biomedical image segmentation framework (the segmentation engine behind TotalSegmentator)
notes: Train custom bone/muscle segmentation when TotalSegmentator classes are not specific enough. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): Apache-2.0.

description: 3D Slicer — free open-source platform for medical image visualisation, DICOM handling, segmentation, registration and quantification
notes: Clinician workstation to inspect/correct segmentations and landmarks before they enter the twin. Accuracy gate, not optional tooling. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): NOASSERTION.

description: Scalismo — library for statistical shape modelling and model-based image analysis
notes: Reconstruct full bone shapes from sparse landmarks/imaging when a full MRI/CT is unavailable. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): Apache-2.0.

description: Automated pipeline generating personalised musculoskeletal models from medical images: CT/MRI -> segmentation -> OpenSim model with muscle attachments and wrapping
notes: End-to-end patient-specific OpenSim generation (uses MSK-STAPLE, already catalogued). New/small project — audit before depending on it. License: not declared in GitHub API metadata (2026-10-21) — check upstream repo.

description: MRI-based workflow for personalised musculoskeletal models: subject-specific joint centres and muscle paths via thin-plate-spline mapping (3D Slicer + OpenSim)
notes: Evidence-driven alternative to generic scaling; published comparison shows generic scaling can misplace e.g. the knee centre by centimetres. License: not declared in GitHub API metadata (2026-10-21) — check upstream repo.

description: RealSense SDK 2.0 (librealsense) — official cross-platform driver/library for RealSense depth cameras including the D455; includes pyrealsense2 and ROS wrappers
notes: Selected-hardware driver (optional RealSense D455 — see docs/hardware.md). Depth is stereo with on-device calibration; use rs-align for RGB-depth alignment and record hardware timestamps for LSL sync. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): Apache-2.0.

description: Kalibr — visual-inertial calibration toolbox for cameras and IMUs
notes: Extrinsic/intrinsic calibration for the selected hardware (cameras + D455 IMU). Accuracy of everything downstream is bounded by this step. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): NOASSERTION.

description: AprilTag — visual fiducial marker system for robotics (pose of tagged objects from camera images)
notes: Known-geometry fiducials for extrinsic calibration checks and validation-rig ground truth (docs/validation-protocol.md). License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): NOASSERTION.

description: Meshroom — node-based photogrammetry toolbox (AliceVision) for 3D reconstruction from photos
notes: Higher-resolution static surface reconstruction from the RGB cameras than iPhone LiDAR; subject must hold still — breathing/movement is the accuracy limit. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): NOASSERTION.

description: OpenCap Monocular — 3D human kinematics and musculoskeletal dynamics from a single smartphone video (WHAM pose, camera/pose optimisation, OpenSim IK and export)
notes: Best-validated single-phone path to OpenSim found so far: preprint arXiv 2603.24733 reports 4.8 deg mean absolute error vs marker mocap for walking, squats and sit-to-stand. Its validation code reads the OpenCap LabValidation dataset (videos + marker-mocap IK). License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; needs SMPL weights (MPI, non-commercial). Benchmark rehabtwin's monocular front-ends against it.

description: Sports2D — joint and segment angles from a single video (RTMPose), with optional OpenSim inverse kinematics
notes: Same author as Pose2Sim; BSD-3-Clause. Planar (2D) angles are only valid when the movement plane faces the camera — useful for quick sagittal screening, not for frontal/transverse posture. Ships a demo video.
